why_this_exists: A19's TNIC is purged of vertical relationships, so it tested product rivals, not 'AI needs power'. Fresard, Hoberg & Phillips (RFS 2020) publish a directed firm-pair-year network of vertical relatedness from 10-K product text matched to BEA input-output vocabulary. Customer momentum (Cohen & Frazzini 2008) and customer/supplier industry momentum (Menzly & Ozbas 2010) are this mechanism; OSAP shows both at t < 1 since 2013 (Step 353). This is their firm-level, full-coverage, free form.

data.network: VTNIC 10% granularity (VertNetwork_10gran.zip, Fresard-Hoberg-Phillips data site). Readme read before registering: rows (year, gvkey1, gvkey2, vertscore) are DIRECTED -- gvkey1's upstream potential relative to gvkey2, i.e. gvkey1 supplies gvkey2. Includes self rows (dropped). Year = fiscal-year datadate year, NOT lagged. Coverage 1989-2021.
data.mapping_and_timing: exactly A19's: farr gvkey->CIK as of July 1 Y+1; year Y used July Y+1 to June Y+2

windows: design 2012-01 to 2018-12; holdout 2019-01 to 2023-06 (VTNIC 2021 is the last year, usable through June 2023)

trials.T1_customers_lead_suppliers_1m: for each firm, its CUSTOMERS are the firms it is upstream of (rows gvkey1 = firm). Keep its 10 highest-vertscore customers in the price panel; signal = vertscore-weighted 21-day return of those customers. Horizon 1 month. This is 'AI booms (customers rise) -> the firms that supply them'.
trials.T2_suppliers_lead_customers_1m: for each firm, its SUPPLIERS are the firms upstream of it (rows gvkey2 = firm). Top 10 by vertscore; signal = their weighted 21-day return. Horizon 1 month.
trials.top_10_rule: declared before download: the 10% granularity file keeps 10% of ALL pairs, so a firm can have hundreds of partners; the nearest 10 is the economically meaningful set. Not varied.
trials.residualisation: A19's: own 21-day return, own 12-1 momentum, leave-self-out SIC2 21-day return

measurement: A19's screen and A19's pass rule word for word (design IC p < bar, decile_shape clears and clears_calibrated, above the 200-draw shuffled-network placebo p95 with partner counts and weights kept, leave-one-SIC2-out and leave-top-10 positive, holdout IC > 0 with the ladder clearing). Positive control as Step 355: same-month co-movement with vertical partners vs random partners, reported before the verdict.
cumulative_search_note: On top of 355 steps; A19 used the same price panel, mapping and harness.
known_weaknesses_declared_up_front: Vertical relatedness is 'potential' from vocabulary overlap with input-output commodities, not observed trade.
Survivorship and SIC carry-forward as A19.
